errors.error_description: Introduced multiple active drivers by adding a second continuous assignment driving the same net (onehot_bus) from a different source.
Instantiated the same module inside a generate block and connected a narrower slice (8 bits) to a wider output port (16 bits), creating a port width mismatch at the instance boundary.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same sequential always_ff block by using a blocking assignment to mask_r alongside non-blocking assignments, creating potential race behavior.
In a combinational always block, assigned hold_en only under a condition without an else/default, inferring a latch and thus mixing sequential behavior into combinational logic.
